description.value: Yum Yum Tree is a casual Chinese-Canadian restaurant in Kelowna that has built a strong local reputation (4.6 stars from nearly 400 Google reviews) for its MSG-free cooking, fresh ingredients, and generous portions. The menu spans appetizers, soups, fried rice, chop suey, chow mein, and a range of chicken, pork, beef, and seafood dishes. It operates primarily as a takeout and pick-up counter, making it a practical quick-stop for hungry cyclists passing through the Gordon Drive corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at yumyumtreekelowna.ca is live and corroborates the OSM name, address (1835 Gordon Dr #153, Kelowna, BC V1Y 3H4), and phone number. The website explicitly states 'PICK UP ONLY' on the main menu view and notes delivery for orders over $80, confirming takeout service. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Gallery page contains generic placeholder-style images and category labels (spaghetti, beef steak, cheese pizza, salmon with tomato sauce) that do not match the actual Chinese-Canadian menu; appears to be unupdated website template content rather than the real menu.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Chinese restaurant with a live website, confirmed address, and strong review presence — a practical meal stop for touring cyclists on Gordon Drive.

Takeout.detail: Website states 'PICK UP ONLY' for the main menu; delivery also available for orders over a minimum threshold

price.label: Casual
price.signal: Most mains $13.95–$18.95, casual Chinese, self-described affordable
